characters.hint: The legs of a human being
characters.object: a person standing, seen from the front, legs apart

lines.where: a long sweep from the top centre down and out to the bottom left
lines.part: the body, running down into the left leg

lines.where: a long sweep from the middle of the first stroke down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: the right leg

characters.hint: A man 人 with outstretched arms
characters.object: a grown person standing facing you, arms stretched out wide and legs apart, making themself as big as they can

lines.where: a long straight line across the middle, from near the left edge to near the right edge
lines.part: both arms, stretched straight out to the sides from hand to hand

lines.where: a long sweep from the top centre, straight down through the centre, then curving out to the bottom left
lines.part: the neck and body, running down into the left leg

lines.where: a long sweep from the centre down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: the right leg

characters.object: one person walking behind another, both seen from the side, both walking to the right

lines.where: a long sweep from the top left curving down to the bottom left
lines.part: the follower's body and back leg

lines.where: a short stroke from the middle of the left half slanting down to the right, ending near the bottom centre
lines.part: the follower's front leg, stepping forward

lines.where: a long sweep from the top centre curving down to the bottom left of the right half
lines.part: the leader's body and back leg

lines.where: a long sweep from the centre down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: the leader's front leg, striding out

characters.hint: A person 亻 leaning against a tree 木
characters.definition: to rest; to stop; to retire
characters.object: a person resting, leaning with their back against a tree

lines.where: a short slanting stroke at the top left, running down to the left
lines.part: the person's head and shoulders, tilted as they lean back

lines.where: a straight line from the middle of the left side down to the bottom left
lines.part: the person's body and legs, standing upright

lines.where: a line across the upper middle of the right part
lines.part: the tree's main branches, spreading left and right

lines.where: a long straight line from the top of the right part down to the bottom, in its middle
lines.part: the tree's trunk, from the crown down to the ground

lines.where: a stroke from the middle of the trunk slanting down to the left
lines.part: a root spreading out to the left

lines.where: a short stroke from the middle of the trunk slanting down to the right
lines.part: a root spreading out to the right

characters.object: a mountain range of three peaks rising from one base, the middle peak the tallest

lines.where: a long straight line down the centre, from the top centre to the bottom
lines.part: the ridge of the tallest, middle peak, its top end the summit

lines.where: a line from the middle of the left side down to the bottom left, turning there to run along the bottom to the bottom right
lines.part: the ridge of the left peak, then the base of the whole range along the ground

lines.where: a straight line from the middle of the right side down to the bottom right
lines.part: the ridge of the right peak

characters.hint: A river running between two banks; compare 川
characters.object: a river running down between its banks, the water splashing out to both sides

lines.where: a long line straight down the centre from the top, ending at the bottom in a small hook to the left
lines.part: the main stream flowing down, curling into a small eddy at the bottom

lines.where: a line from the middle left running across to the centre, then turning to sweep down to the bottom left
lines.part: a side current branching off to the left and splashing down

lines.where: a short slanting stroke at the upper right, running down towards the centre
lines.part: a spray of water splashing up from the stream on the right

lines.where: a long sweep from the centre down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: a current flowing out to the right

characters.object: a tree, with its branches above and its roots below

lines.where: a line across the upper part, from left to right
lines.part: the main branches, spreading out to both sides

lines.where: a long straight line down the middle, from the top to the bottom
lines.part: the trunk

lines.where: a sweep from the centre of the trunk down and out to the bottom left
lines.part: the root spreading out to the left

lines.where: a sweep from the centre of the trunk down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: the root spreading out to the right

characters.hint: Two trees 木 representing a forest
characters.object: two trees standing side by side, a grove

lines.where: a line across the upper part of the left half
lines.part: the left tree's branches

lines.where: a long straight line down the middle of the left half
lines.part: the left tree's trunk

lines.where: a sweep from the centre of the left trunk down to the bottom left
lines.part: the left tree's root, spreading left

lines.where: a short dot-like stroke beside the left trunk, slanting down to the right
lines.part: the left tree's short right root

lines.where: a line across the upper part of the right half
lines.part: the right tree's branches

lines.where: a long straight line down the middle of the right half
lines.part: the right tree's trunk

lines.where: a sweep from the centre of the right trunk down to the left
lines.part: the right tree's root, spreading left

lines.where: a sweep from the centre of the right trunk down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: the right tree's root, spreading right

characters.hint: Many trees 木 forming a forest
characters.object: three trees, one standing higher up behind and two in front, a forest

lines.where: a line across the upper part of the top half
lines.part: the top tree's branches

lines.where: a straight line down the centre of the top half
lines.part: the top tree's trunk

lines.where: a short sweep from the top tree's trunk down to the left
lines.part: the top tree's root, spreading left

lines.where: a short stroke from the top tree's trunk down to the right
lines.part: the top tree's root, spreading right

lines.where: a line across the lower left quarter, near its top
lines.part: the lower left tree's branches

lines.where: a straight line down the middle of the lower left quarter
lines.part: the lower left tree's trunk

lines.where: a sweep from the lower left trunk down to the bottom left
lines.part: the lower left tree's root, spreading left

lines.where: a short dot-like stroke beside the lower left trunk
lines.part: the lower left tree's short right root

lines.where: a line across the lower right quarter, near its top
lines.part: the lower right tree's branches

lines.where: a straight line down the middle of the lower right quarter
lines.part: the lower right tree's trunk

lines.where: a sweep from the lower right trunk down to the left
lines.part: the lower right tree's root, spreading left

lines.where: a sweep from the lower right trunk down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: the lower right tree's root, spreading right

characters.object: a wide-open mouth, seen from the front

lines.where: a straight line down the left side
lines.part: the left corner and left side of the open lips

lines.where: a line across the top from left to right, turning down at the top right to run down the right side
lines.part: the upper lip, curving down into the right corner of the mouth

lines.where: a line across the bottom from left to right
lines.part: the lower lip

characters.object: the sun

lines.where: a long straight line down the left side
lines.part: the left rim of the sun

lines.where: a line across the top, turning down at the top right to run down the right side
lines.part: the top and the right rim of the sun

lines.where: a short line across the middle
lines.part: the bright spot at the sun's heart, a band of light across its centre

lines.where: a line across the bottom
lines.part: the bottom rim of the sun

characters.object: a crescent moon, standing upright

lines.where: a long line down the left side, curving slightly out to the bottom left at its foot
lines.part: the outer curve, the back, of the crescent

lines.where: a line across the top, turning down at the top right to run down the right side, ending in a small hook to the left at the bottom
lines.part: the top horn and the inner edge of the crescent, curling at the bottom into the lower horn

lines.where: a short line across, in the upper middle
lines.part: a shadowed crater on the moon's face

lines.where: a short line across, in the lower middle
lines.part: a second crater on the moon's face

characters.hint: The light of the sun 日 and moon 月
characters.definition: bright, clear; to explain, to understand, to shed light
characters.object: the sun on the left and the crescent moon on the right, shining together

lines.where: a straight line down the left side of the left part, upper half
lines.part: the left rim of the sun

lines.where: a line across the top of the left part, turning down to run down its right side
lines.part: the top and the right rim of the sun

lines.where: a short line across the middle of the left part
lines.part: the bright spot at the sun's heart

lines.where: a short line across the left part, below the middle
lines.part: the bottom rim of the sun

lines.where: a long line down the left side of the right part, curving out to the bottom left at its foot
lines.part: the outer curve, the back, of the crescent moon

lines.where: a line across the top of the right part, turning down to run down its right side, ending in a small hook to the left at the bottom
lines.part: the top horn and the inner edge of the crescent, curling into the lower horn

lines.where: a short line across the right part, in its upper middle
lines.part: a shadowed crater on the moon's face

lines.where: a short line across the right part, in its lower middle
lines.part: a second crater on the moon's face

characters.definition: fire, flame; to burn; anger, rage
characters.object: a fire, a big flame leaping up with sparks flying off on both sides

lines.where: a short dot-like stroke in the upper left, slanting down to the right
lines.part: a small flame or spark leaping off to the left

lines.where: a short stroke in the upper right, slanting down to the left
lines.part: a small flame or spark leaping off to the right

lines.where: a long sweep from the top centre down and out to the bottom left
lines.part: the left edge of the big flame, from its tip down to its base

lines.where: a long sweep from the centre down and out to the bottom right
lines.part: the right edge of the big flame, flaring out at its base

characters.hint: Rain drops falling from a cloud 帀
characters.object: rain falling from a cloud that hangs across the sky

lines.where: a line across the very top, from left to right
lines.part: the top of the sky, the upper edge of the cloud

lines.where: a line from below the top line, down the left side
lines.part: the left edge of the cloud, hanging down

lines.where: a line across, below the top line, turning down at the right to run down the right side, ending in a small hook at the bottom
lines.part: the body of the cloud and its right edge, hanging down

lines.where: a straight line down the centre, from the top line to the middle
lines.part: a stream of rain pouring from the middle of the cloud

lines.where: a short dot in the left half, upper
lines.part: a raindrop

lines.where: a short dot in the left half, lower
lines.part: a raindrop

lines.where: a short dot in the right half, upper
lines.part: a raindrop

lines.where: a short dot in the right half, lower
lines.part: a raindrop

characters.hint: The plots of a rice paddy
characters.object: a rice paddy seen from above, divided by raised banks into four plots

lines.where: a straight line down the left side
lines.part: the bank along the left edge of the field

lines.where: a line across the top, turning down at the top right to run down the right side
lines.part: the banks along the top and the right edge

lines.where: a line across the middle
lines.part: the bank dividing the upper plots from the lower

lines.where: a straight line down the middle
lines.part: the bank dividing the left plots from the right

lines.where: a line across the bottom
lines.part: the bank along the bottom edge

characters.object: a gateway, two posts under a crossbeam

lines.where: a short dot at the top left, slanting down to the right
lines.part: an iron latch at the top of the left post

lines.where: a long straight line down the left side
lines.part: the left gatepost

lines.where: a line across the top, turning down at the top right to run down the right side, ending in a small hook to the left at the bottom
lines.part: the crossbeam and the right gatepost, its foot set in the ground

characters.object: two bamboo stalks with their leaves hanging down

lines.where: a short slanting stroke at the top left, running down to the left
lines.part: a leaf hanging from the top of the left stalk

lines.where: a short line across, in the upper left
lines.part: a second leaf or twig on the left stalk

lines.where: a straight line down the left side, from the middle to the bottom
lines.part: the left bamboo stalk

lines.where: a short slanting stroke at the top of the right half, running down to the left
lines.part: a leaf hanging from the top of the right stalk

lines.where: a short line across, in the upper right
lines.part: a second leaf or twig on the right stalk

lines.where: a long straight line down the right side, from the middle to the bottom, ending in a small hook to the left
lines.part: the right bamboo stalk, its foot curving where it meets the ground

characters.object: the wooden frame around the mouth of a well, seen from above

lines.where: a line across the upper part, from left to right
lines.part: the upper log of the frame

lines.where: a longer line across the lower part, from left to right
lines.part: the lower log of the frame

lines.where: a long line down the left of centre, from the top, slanting slightly out to the bottom left
lines.part: the left log of the frame

lines.where: a long straight line down the right of centre, from the top to the bottom
lines.part: the right log of the frame

characters.hint: Bamboo strips 冂 tied together to form a book
characters.object: an ancient book, a row of bamboo slips bound together by a cord

lines.where: a long straight line down the left side
lines.part: the first bamboo slip

lines.where: a line across the top of the left half, turning down to run to the bottom, ending in a small hook
lines.part: the top edge of the first pair of slips and the second slip

lines.where: a long straight line down the right of centre
lines.part: the third bamboo slip

lines.where: a line across the top of the right half, turning down at the right to run to the bottom, ending in a small hook
lines.part: the top edge of the second pair of slips and the fourth slip

lines.where: a long line across the middle, from the left edge to the right edge
lines.part: the cord that binds all the slips together

characters.object: the head of a ram, seen from the front, with its horns

lines.where: a short stroke at the top left, slanting down to the right
lines.part: the left horn

lines.where: a short stroke at the top right, slanting down to the left
lines.part: the right horn

lines.where: a line across, below the horns
lines.part: the brow, across the top of the face

lines.where: a shorter line across the middle
lines.part: the eyes, as one line across the face

lines.where: a long line across, below the middle, wider than the others
lines.part: the ears, sticking out to both sides

lines.where: a long straight line down the centre, from below the horns to the bottom
lines.part: the long face and nose, down to the chin

characters.definition: to protrude, to bulge out; convex
characters.object: a stone block with a raised part bulging up from the middle of its top, like a podium

lines.where: a short straight line from the top, left of centre, down to the middle
lines.part: the left side of the raised part

lines.where: a short line across the middle, from the left edge to the first stroke
lines.part: the top of the block on the left

lines.where: a straight line from the middle of the left side down to the bottom left
lines.part: the left side of the block

lines.where: a line across the top of the raised part, down its right side, out across the middle and down the right side to the bottom
lines.part: the top and right side of the raised part, then the top and right side of the block

lines.where: a line across the bottom
lines.part: the base of the block, on the ground
